Not judged: no-2 gateway has no size (give it under the shot's "things").
The lowest story thing is no-2-man-6, reaching 0.712 down (limit 0.7).

Story things in the button strip (0.45 to 0.95 down) end at: no-2 gateway 0.47, no-2-man-1 0.32, no-2-man-2 0.46, no-2-man-3 0.61, no-2-man-4 0.76, no-2-man-5 0.26, no-2-man-6 0.38, no-2-man-7 0.54, no-2-man-8 0.84 across (limit 0.95).

The story things stand together in the street: the loneliest, man-4, is 0.19 m from man-5 (limit 0.3 m between footprints).

The spots that can be worked out before rendering (where the lines meet 0.50, 0.50; middle of no-2 gateway 0.47, 0.53; middle of the story things 0.44, 0.60) span 0.06 x 0.10 (the plan keeps them inside 0.3 x 0.4 so the brightest parts and the warm light have room within the rule's 0.4 x 0.5).

In the bottom-left quarter, where the eye enters, the boxes cover: no-2-man-1 2.5% (over its 2%), no-2-man-2 2.2% (over its 2%), no-2-man-3 0.2%, no-2-man-5 3.1% (over its 2%), no-2-man-6 3.1% (over its 2%), no-2-man-7 1.9%, no-2-worker-1 0.5%, no-2-worker-2 0.3% (limit 1% a thing, 2% for a story thing in a crowd shot; a box covers more than the thing in it, so these are upper bounds).

checks.about: no-2-worker-2's face or profile shows (it faces 86 degrees from the camera); its head is 17 px tall at 21.85 m (composed spot (end)); the house limit 24 px is invented and untested.

Figures with their backs to the camera, at the nearest camera place along the slide: no-2-man-6 7.48 m, no-2-man-5 7.58 m, no-2-man-7 7.60 m, no-2-man-8 7.75 m, no-2-man-3 8.28 m, no-2-man-1 8.30 m, no-2-man-4 8.38 m, no-2-man-2 8.42 m, no-2-worker-1 18.29 m (at least 6.0 m: a 1.75 m man is a quarter of the frame there; nearest no-2-man-6 at composed spot (end)).

Crowd "men at No. 2": gaps between neighbours' shoulders in a row (0.47 m shoulders): no-2-man-5-no-2-man-6 0.13 m, no-2-man-6-no-2-man-7 0.33 m, no-2-man-7-no-2-man-8 1.03 m, no-2-man-1-no-2-man-2 0.33 m, no-2-man-2-no-2-man-3 0.33 m, no-2-man-3-no-2-man-4 0.33 m (house range 0.3 to 0.5 m).
checks.fix: Check by eye: no-2-man-5-no-2-man-6 0.13 m, no-2-man-7-no-2-man-8 1.03 m (a back-row man standing between two of the front row fills a wide gap).

checks.about: Crowd "men at No. 2" from this shot: the closest two heads, no-2-man-1 and no-2-man-6, are 1.91 head widths apart on screen (at least 1.0, so each head can be counted).
Crowd "men at No. 2": the most hidden figure, no-2-man-1, shows about 0% of its box (at least 50%; boxes, so a figure behind a gap between two others shows more than this).
checks.fix: Move no-2-man-1 sideways into a gap, or check on the render.

checks.about: The 1.20 m slide brings the nearest painted thing, no-2-drum-diesel (its nearest corner 6.50 m away at the end), 1.185 times nearer; the painting's 2672 rows allow 1.286; the longest slide for it is 1.86 m.
The painted ground at the frame's bottom edge (2.92 m away) comes 1.411 times nearer (not counted: nobody has judged whether its softness shows; --count-ground counts it).

Casting the film frame's corners and edge middles onto the floor every 10% of the slide, the plate needs a lens of at least 63.53 degrees (with the 0.03 fade band at its edge); the house plate lens is 64.4 (film 60.4 + 4.0); the camera may turn 1.38 degrees each way inside it.
For the slide's worst magnification the plate would need 2462 rows of real detail; the painter returns 2672 (the house plate is 1536 x 2730).
